_about: Facts the source checker verifies on every PR and weekly (scripts/study-abroad/verify-sources.mjs). Each entry: the official page, the exact sentence on it, and the value that sentence must contain. Add an entry only after a person has read the page; the checker then keeps it honest.

entries.quote: I-901 SEVIS Fee F or M visa applicants (full payment) $350
per month (for up to 9 months) for courses outside London
You must have this money for at least 28 days in a row.
The end date of the 28-day period must be within 31 days of the date you apply for your visa.
APP ST8. In ST 12.3(a), for “£1529”, substitute “£1570”.
entries.note: HC 584 says APP ST8 to APP ST10 take effect on 30 November 2026 for applications made on or after that date.
